pr_title: Add reflect impls for bevy_math curve structs
pr_body:
# Objective

Fixes #13189

## Solution

To add the reflect impls I needed to make all the struct fields pub. I don't think there's any harm for these types, but just a note for review.

issue_context.title: Cleanup: `Reflect` on `bevy_math`'s curve structs
issue_context.body:
## What problem does this solve or what need does it fill?

Our cubic curves and NURBS are presently lacking `Reflect` implementations in `bevy_reflect`. This is especially important for `CubicCurve` and `RationalCurve`, which might actually be passed around in user data.

## Additional context

For end-users to derive `Reflect` on structs that contain math data types, those math types need some amount of reflection, which is something that we have to supply.

review_comments: I can't speak for `bevy_math` folks, so I'll just ask: is there any reason we would want these to stay private?
I can't see one. There's no invariants to uphold, and these math types don't have much room for implementation details to change. But happy to hear other thoughts.
These are fine to be pub.
It looks like some of these types could also register `ReflectDefault`. Could we add those registrations as well?
